search_strategy: The agent first tried a narrow Mattermost keyword search (python3 /tmp/mm.py identity, step 33) which surfaced fragments of several herrings/clues (both r1 whole-dict herrings, the r2 uuid4-nocache herring, l-keys-count, l-backend-default, l-retries-fork, rev2, l-key-on-disk) but only messages literally matching 'identity'. Recognising the chat held 'the real design discussion,' it then (step 35) wrote a dumper that pulled every channel's full post history via the Mattermost REST API into /tmp/chat.txt (10309 lines, all 10 channels, full date range), and drove the rest of its reading off targeted greps against that dump: 'compute_run_identity|run_identity|IDENTITY_BACKEND_PARAM_KEYS|identity stamp|run_stamp|identity_version|RunIdentity|v3-' (step 35), 'component' (step 50), and 'adopt|mismatch|upgraded|matched|reconcile|stamp' (step 55), each followed by sed reads of the surrounding 40-60-line windows to get full conversational context rather than isolated grep lines -- e.g. it explicitly read 7141-7152, 7190-7240, 7880-7920, 9340-9400, 9780-9830, 10100-10160, 6360-6420 in full. This caught the great majority of the 48 remarks (38/48, all 4 herrings and all 4 reversals). The 10 it missed (l-params-none, l-schema-order, l-window-reuse, l-completions-object, l-backend-resolved, l-genparams-empty, l-system-prompt, l-params-copy, r2.l2, r2.l11) share a common cause: none contain any of the grepped terms (no 'compute_run_identity', no 'component', no 'adopt/mismatch/stamp'), so they were never pulled up even though they sat inside the same full dump the agent already had on disk -- a keyword-driven read of a fully-available corpus rather than a genuinely exhaustive one. No wiki or mail carriers exist for this task (per the answer key, g4 is chat-only), so no wiki/mail search was needed or attempted. The agent also cross-checked several remarks against the repository's own source (e.g. deriving LLM.backend's resolution directly from llm.py rather than from the chat clue that stated it), and performed an explicit pre-push checklist (lines 10640-10660) walking back through its notes against the shipped diff before merging.

Because every one of the 8 graded facts had 3-6 redundant surfaced carriers (see passed_facts), the 10 unsurfaced remarks caused no fact loss -- this task's redundant plant made the run robust to an incomplete keyword search.
